snippet.title: Eyes Of The ElderWood || Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Mark your calendars! Eyes Of The ElderWood arrives on Steam Early Access on June 26th!

Starting today, you can also play the demo of Eyes Of The ElderWood. Step into the role of Dalia, Laura’s sister, and uncover the first dark secrets hidden within the Kashubian forests in this narrative prologue.

Add to wishlist: 
⚫ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963050/Eyes_Of_The_ElderWood/
🔵 https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019123/


Eyes Of The ElderWood is a first-person adventure horror set in Kashubian folklore, emphasizing diverse locations, challenges, and enemies. Draw spells to solve puzzles and deal with foes, or fight using a revolver. Keep an eye on your sanity level to avoid descending into madness.

As development progresses and new chapters are added, the game’s price will gradually increase:

• €5.99 - Early Access launch
• €9.99 - Content update
• €12.99 - Continued game expansion
• €14.99 - Full version
